Apply migrations with old APIs/workers stopped, then deploy matching code; mixed-version routing authority is not supported. Prior Feature052 fresh-database cutover restrictions still apply when upgrading databases predating0089. Full provider expense remains immutable in authoritative accounting records. No balances or historical prices are reset. Disposable forward migration, native SQL parity, receipt settlement and restricted worker-role tests cover the new authority.
